description: AQA A Level Mathematics 7357. Topics A to S from the AQA specification. Paper 1 is Pure (A to I). Paper 2 is Paper 1 content plus Vectors (J) and Mechanics (P to S). Paper 3 is Paper 1 content plus Statistics (K to O). Each paper is 2 hours, 100 marks, one third of the A-level. Topics are ordered by what they depend on, not by exam order. The paper field is the primary paper for that topic; A to I are also examined on Papers 2 and 3 as Paper 1 content.
title: AQA A Level Mathematics 7357

topics.description: Mathematical argument and proof: proof by deduction, exhaustion, counter-example and contradiction.
topics.title: A: Proof

topics.description: Quadratics, surds, indices, polynomials, inequalities, graphs of functions, composite and inverse functions, transformations and partial fractions.
topics.title: B: Algebra and functions

topics.description: Straight lines, circles, parametric equations and the geometry of the (x, y) plane.
topics.title: C: Coordinate geometry in the (x, y) plane

topics.description: Arithmetic and geometric sequences and series, sigma notation, recurrence relations and the binomial expansion.
topics.title: D: Sequences and series

topics.description: Trigonometric ratios, graphs, identities, equations, radians and exact values.
topics.title: E: Trigonometry

topics.description: Exponential functions, logarithms, the laws of logarithms and solving exponential equations.
topics.title: F: Exponentials and logarithms

topics.description: Differentiation from first principles, the product, quotient and chain rules, stationary points and optimisation.
topics.title: G: Differentiation

topics.description: Integration as the reverse of differentiation, definite integrals, area under a curve and differential equations.
topics.title: H: Integration

topics.description: Location of roots, the Newton-Raphson method, numerical integration and iterative methods.
topics.title: I: Numerical methods

topics.description: Vectors in two and three dimensions, magnitude, direction, dot product and vector equations of lines.
topics.title: J: Vectors

topics.description: Populations and samples, sampling methods, bias and the large data set.
topics.title: K: Statistical sampling

topics.description: Data presentation, measures of location and spread, correlation and regression.
topics.title: L: Data presentation and interpretation

topics.description: Probability, Venn diagrams, tree diagrams, conditional probability and independent events.
topics.title: M: Probability

topics.description: Binomial and normal distributions, discrete and continuous random variables.
topics.title: N: Statistical distributions

topics.description: Hypothesis testing for the binomial distribution and for correlation.
topics.title: O: Statistical hypothesis testing

topics.description: Quantities, units, scalars and vectors in mechanics, modelling with forces and motion.
topics.title: P: Quantities and units in mechanics

topics.description: Motion in a straight line, SUVAT equations, velocity-time graphs and calculus in kinematics.
topics.title: Q: Kinematics

topics.description: Forces, Newton's laws, friction, connected particles and resolving forces.
topics.title: R: Forces and Newton's laws

topics.description: Moments, equilibrium and turning effects of forces.
topics.title: S: Moments
